title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Mercedes-AMG One
description:
The Mercedes-AMG One has a Formula One engine in it. Not an engine inspired by Formula One. A road-going version of the one-point-six-litre turbo V six from Mercedes' own Formula One cars. And hidden inside that fact are two secrets that almost nobody talks about. One of them explains why the car arrived years late. The other explains a bill that every owner has to face. Here is the twist. Wikipedia says the engine lasts about fifty thousand kilometres, after which owners must return the car to be refurbished. And the other secret is a number that sounds tiny. It is twelve hundred. Stay to the end, because twelve hundred is the reason this car was late.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
